title: Nimitz Tic Tac acceleration and power estimates

tellings.quote: in the case of the Nimtt, we estimate the acceleration of the Tic Tac falling from 28,000 feet to sea level at 7.5 seconds or so, 78 seconds.

plain: In 2004, off Southern California near the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz, the "Tic Tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint, is said to have dropped from 28,000 feet to sea level in a tiny fraction of time, which implies huge acceleration and power. Kevin Knuth, a scientist who has studied the case, gives his team's estimate on the show, though his figure comes out garbled: "we estimate the acceleration of the Tic Tac falling from 28,000 feet to sea level at 7.5 seconds or so, 78 seconds." Numbers like these would put the object far beyond any known aircraft.
